body_markdown:
**Allient Inc. to Present Precision Motion Technologies at SEMICON West 2026**


[Download printer-friendly version](https://allient.com/d/?h=dec6e95)


**Buffalo, N.Y. – 6 October, 2026 –** **** Allient Inc. (Nasdaq: ALNT) (“Allient” or the “Company”), a global designer and manufacturer of advanced specialty motor, Motion, Controls, and Power products and solutions for targeted industries and applications, has today announced it will showcase its precision motion technologies at SEMICON West 2026, taking place October 13–15 at the Moscone Center in San Francisco, California.


Visit us at Booth #5683 to explore our technologies, or[contact us](https://allient.com/contact-us/) to schedule a meeting during the event.


At SEMICON West 2026, Allient will present a range of products, including:


**Precision Motion Stage Demos:**


- ThruSight-Theta and ThruSight Focus
- Open-center XY stage
- Asymmetric XY
- Hybrid Hexapod


**Frameless Motors:**


- High-performance, slotless, frameless brushless motor kits (TG Series)
- Premium line of slotless, frameless, inner-rotor brushless motor kits (LS Series)
- Frameless axial flux motors for low-profile applications (SA Series)
- High-performance frameless direct-drive brushless torque motors (MegaFlux Series)
- Frameless torque motors designed for advanced robotics and precision motion control (ElectroFlux Series)


**Linear Motors:**


- High-force ironless linear motors for demanding motion control applications (P-Series)
- Ironless linear motors for compact, high-precision applications (C-Series)
- Linear motors configured to application requirements (Custom Linear Motors)


**Servo Drives:**


- Pyxmos™ Module


The ThruSight-Theta stage, mounted on top of an open-center XY stage, demonstrates how Allient's products can be built into precision Semiconduct fabrication equipment, combining precision XY movement with continuous precision rotary motion while allowing a light source through the clear aperture. The system is ideal for semiconductor applications, including metrology and various forms of inspection, or wafer handling/processing.


“We’re looking forward to presenting our precision motion technologies and demonstrating how our products can be integrated into systems at SEMICON West 2026,” said Robert Mastromattei, Chief Commercial Officer & Group President at Allient. “This provides an opportunity to showcase the capabilities of our products and discuss how they can support customer applications.”


For more information about Allient’s upcoming trade shows and events, visit[here](https://allient.com/trade-shows-events/) .


**ABOUT ALLIENT INC.**


Allient (Nasdaq: ALNT) is a global engineering and manufacturing enterprise that develops solutions to drive the future of market-moving industries, including medical, life sciences, aerospace and defense, industrial automation, robotics, semi-conductor, transportation, agriculture, construction, and facility infrastructure. A family of globally responsible companies, Allient takes a One-Team approach to “Connect What Matters” and provides the most robust, reliable, and high-value products and systems by utilizing its core Motion, Controls, and Power technologies and platforms.


Headquartered in Buffalo, N.Y., Allient employs more than 2,500 team members around the world.
